summary.text: Tammy Nichols represents Idaho Senate District 10, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists a Middleton, Idaho, mailing address.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Nichols was born and raised in Boise and graduated from BYU-Idaho with a degree in science.
It says Nichols has experience in the banking and medical industries and is a Canyon County precinct committeeman.
